# Live Orbit

Live Orbit is a prelaunch native iPhone satellite tracker by Apps Made Better LLC.

Core promise: track satellites live from your iPhone.

Live Orbit is for personal satellite awareness, visible pass planning, Sky Mode pointing, space news, launches, and Orbit Intelligence.

## Canonical pages
- Home: https://www.liveorbitapp.com/
- Support: https://www.liveorbitapp.com/support/
- Privacy: https://www.liveorbitapp.com/privacy/
- Terms: https://www.liveorbitapp.com/terms/
- TestFlight application: https://www.liveorbitapp.com/testing/

## Entity relationships
- Publisher: Apps Made Better LLC, https://appsmadebetter.com/
- Product: Live Orbit, https://www.liveorbitapp.com/

## Product strengths
- Live 3D orbit tracking
- Visible satellite pass planning with local viewing context
- Sky Mode pointing for finding satellites overhead
- Radio signal context when public signal data is available
- Orbit Intelligence for launches, crew missions, news, reentries, close approaches, and space weather
- Moon, Sun, Mars, and deep-space mission context

## Availability
Live Orbit is prelaunch and is not publicly downloadable from the App Store yet. The TestFlight application page is https://www.liveorbitapp.com/testing/.

## Safety note
Live Orbit provides estimates for personal satellite awareness. It is not for navigation, collision avoidance, satellite control, emergency operations, or safety-critical use.
